Description

SUMMARY:

The Software Engineer will develop and maintain software in support of user requirements for Next Generation Constructive (NGC). NGC is a next-generation, constructive training platform that supports large-scale, multi-domain operational training for commanders and staff. Responsibilities include full lifecycle software development to include software requirements analysis, software design, software coding, software integration and testing.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES:

Work through full-cycle software development that includes requirements analysis, design, implementation and testing
Identification, documentation, and repair of software defects
Designing, coding and debugging applications in various software languages, primarily in Java
Work with leads, testers, subject matter experts, and other developers in an Agile development environment
Understands and adheres to project schedules and stays within established budgets

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree in technical discipline such as computer science, information technology, systems or software engineering from an accredited college or university
Position requires US Citizenship and the ability to obtain security clearance

 

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES:

·        Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Design/Programming

·        Solid understanding of Agile development principles

·        Proficiency in Java or similar programming languages

·        Familiarity with Linux operating systems

·        Familiarity with version control systems such as Git

·        Familiarity with game engines such as Godot or Unity

·        Familiarity with multi-threaded applications

·        Familiarity with UML diagrams

·        Previous work experience as either an intern or a full-time engineer in DoD Software Systems is a plus

JOB CONTEXT / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position is operated in an indoor and outdoor environments. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to sit, stand, walk, and perform general office functions. The employee may be required to sit for extended periods of time.
